scripts.test:backend:unit: cross-env ENV=test PYTHONPATH=backend pytest -q --no-cov backend/api/tests -m "not slow"
scripts.test:backend:bots:unit: cross-env ENV=test PYTHONPATH=backend pytest -q --no-cov backend/api/tests/routes/bots -m "not slow"
scripts.test:bots:unit: cross-env ENV=test PYTHONPATH=u-stock-bots pytest -q --no-cov u-stock-bots -m "not slow"
scripts.test:quick: npm run test:frontend:dashboard && npm run test:backend:unit && npm run test:bots:unit
scripts.test:frontend:all: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:frontend:context
scripts.test:all: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:bots
scripts.test:all:cov: npm run test:frontend:cov && npm run test:backend:cov && npm run test:bots:cov
scripts.debug:config: cross-env ENV=test PYTHONPATH=backend python -c "import api.core.config as c; print('CONFIG_FILE=', c.__file__); s=c.get_settings(); print('TYPE=', type(s)); print('ENV=', getattr(s,'env',None)); print('HAS_DB_URL=', hasattr(s,'database_url')); print('DICT_KEYS=', list(getattr(s,'__dict__',{}).keys()))"
